text:
Leah: follow-up from the streaming postmortem: we need a compact remediation plan with owners, short timelines, and recurring detection for patterns. linking the PM notes: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/streaming-197049 (summary pinned)

Marcus: i can take the server-side chunking race + repro harness. initial findings point to kv-evict callbacks racing with final flush. prototype fix: per-stream flush fencing token. ETA: 6 days for repro PR, 14 days for safe-rollout.

Ivy: i'll own observability and synthetic detection. plan: add partial_flag in responses, emit per-request metadata (request_id, route, model, region), and run a lightweight synthetic stream every hour from 5 regions. ETA: 4 days for metrics, 10 days for dashboards + PD rule.

Dmitri: client-side here. i'll implement capped full-jitter backoff for reconnects, handshake timeout clamp, and client telemetry for reconnect_reason. prototype in 5 days, canary in 3w.

Leah: please list concrete action items with owners and due dates so we can triage into the remediation board.

Marcus: items from my side:
- RMD-301: Add repro harness that simulates mid-stream KV eviction and unit/integration tests. owner: Marcus. due: 2026-03-31.
- RMD-302: Implement fenced flush (safe-chunking) to avoid truncated chunks. owner: Marcus. due: 2026-04-12.

Ivy: observability/action items:
- RMD-303: Add partial_flag + per-request telemetry (request_id, route, model, region) and surface in metrics. owner: Ivy. due: 2026-03-29.
- RMD-304: Synthetic hourly stream from 5 regions + weekly digest to #eng-runtime. owner: Ivy. due: 2026-03-30.
- RMD-305: Alerting: warning if partial_ratio >0.12% for 15m; page if >0.5% for 5m OR synthetic fail >2 runs. owner: Ivy & SRE. due: 2026-03-31.

Dmitri: client items:
- RMD-306: Client lib: capped exponential backoff + full jitter + handshake clamp; emit reconnect_reason and reconnect_attempt_count. owner: Dmitri. due: 2026-04-02.
- RMD-307: Add opt-in feature-flag `client.backoff_v2` and a debug endpoint for reconnect tests. owner: Dmitri. due: 2026-04-05.

Leah: nice. let's add canary + rollback policy with measurable criteria. proposed rollback: auto-revert if partial_ratio in canary region increases >20% absolute or >3x baseline for 15m.

Marcus: risk note  fenced flush may add ~10-60ms to final-chunk latency on some streams. we'll measure p50/p95/p99 during canary. rollback path: flip feature flag and revert PR. i'll document revert commands in the ticket.

Ivy: infra request: ops-bot, please create INFRA ticket to wire canary rollback hook and region toggle for synthetic streams.

ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-901 and assigned to infra-oncall. link: https://redwood.internal/infra/INFRA-901

Dmitri: telemetry detail: reconnect_reason ∈ {handshake_timeout, network_error, server_close, client_exit}. i'll also tag telemetry with client_version to help rollbacks by cohort.

Leah: check-in cadence: twice-weekly syncs Tue/Thu 09:00 PST until RMD-302 & RMD-306 are deployed and canaryed. ops-bot: please schedule recurring invites and attach remediation board link.

ops-bot: scheduled "Streaming remediation sync" Tue/Thu 09:00 PST starting 2026-03-24. board link: https://redwood.internal/remediations/1970501122

Marcus: opening repro PR today, will tag Dmitri to coordinate client-side interplay tests.

Ivy: i'll feature-flag metrics change and start feeding staging dashboards. will also add a weekly anomaly job that correlates model warmup/load events with partial spikes and posts summary to #eng-runtime.

Dmitri: will add client unit tests for handshake edgecases and a small end-to-end job that can be run in staging to simulate flaky networks.

Leah: owners recap: Marcus (server chunking/tests), Ivy (observability/synthetics/alerts), Dmitri (client reconnect/backoff/telemetry), Leah (coordination + PD thresholds). next check-in: 2026-03-26 09:00 PST. please update RMD tickets with status + blockers before the meeting.

incident-bot: postmortem tasks logged and linked to remediation board: https://redwood.internal/remediations/1970501122

Leah: closing the follow-up for now; reopen if new data from canary. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
